description: This file defines the ViewLeaveEntitlementController class, which manages the logic for viewing leave entitlements within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with various services to retrieve employee, leave type, and leave period data, and prepares components for rendering with appropriate properties.

classes.name: ViewLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the leave entitlement view, including fetching employee, leave type, and leave period data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee, leave type, and leave period data based on request parameters.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds leave type information to the component if leaveTypeId is provided in the request.

methods.name: addLeavePeriodProp
methods.description: Adds leave period data to the component, either from request parameters or default current leave period.
